t2v.heading: Prompt
t2v.promptLabelHint: (describe video content, camera work, and motion in detail)
t2v.promptPlaceholder: Example: A miniature city built from cardboard and bottle caps, coming alive at night. A cardboard train slowly passes by, small lights dot its surface, illuminating the path ahead.
t2v.tipsTitle: Tips for writing a good prompt
t2v.tips1: Subject: specific details of people/objects/scenes (colors, materials, expressions)
t2v.tips3: Camera: push in / pull out / orbit / top-down / low-angle
t2v.tips4: Atmosphere: lighting, time of day, weather, mood
t2v.tips5: Length limit: ≤2500 Chinese chars / 5000 non-Chinese chars
t2v.statusDefault: Fill in prompt, then click "Generate Video"

settings.title: Settings
settings.apiKeyNote: Stored only in your browser's localStorage, never sent to any third party.
settings.regionNote: Note: API Key, model, and Endpoint must be in the same region. Cross-region calls will fail.
settings.endpointNote: Official Bailian auto-selects endpoint by region; proxy uses third-party address with potentially different rate limits or billing.
settings.apiKeyNoteT8: t8star uses a separate key from DashScope. Both are stored independently and swap when you change endpoint.
settings.t8OnlyImageNote: t8star only serves the gpt-image-2 image model — video generation is unavailable.

footer.tip: API Key and images are transmitted only between your browser and this local service. Video links are valid for 24 hours — download promptly.
